page: Microsoft Azure D32ps_v6 is a general purpose virtual machine powered by ARM64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated physical cores based on the Microsoft ARM Neoverse-N2 design, clocked at 3.4 GHz with one thread per core. The processor is backed by 64 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 128 MB L3 cache. It incorporates hardware-accelerated AES cryptography instructions, though x86-specific vector extensions such as AVX and AMX are absent by design. System memory comprises 128.0 GB of RAM, sustaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance has no bundled local storage, operating instead with remote disk connectivity through Premium Storage support, and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong parallel computing performance and high memory efficiency. The 32 physical cores achieve a top-tier passmark memory score of 3314.64, complemented by uncached read bandwidth of 450.97 GB/sec and uncached write bandwidth of 188.48 GB/sec in 256MB blocks. Multi-core compute benchmarks are strong, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 19998.0 and a stress-ng multi-core measurement of 66298.79. Single-threaded benchmarks, including Geekbench single-core (1688.0) and stress-ng single-core (2075.08), operate within average brackets. While CPU-based large language model inference shows limitations on complex 70B models, smaller scale serving throughput is notable, delivering 52.72 GB/sec in static web tests and 61.71 million operations per second on Redis SET benchmarks.

The hardware configuration provides strong cost efficiency by using dedicated physical ARM cores without hyperthreading penalties, yielding consistent performance across heavy concurrency. Without integrated local NVMe storage, the instance relies entirely on network-attached storage architectures, which users must factor into I/O design. Microsoft Azure D32ps_v6 is well suited for memory-sensitive enterprise applications, relational and in-memory database operations, high-throughput static web serving, software compilation tasks, and multi-threaded background processing.
description: Microsoft Azure D32ps_v6 is an ARM64 general purpose instance powered by 32 dedicated Neoverse-N2 physical cores running at 3.4 GHz, paired with 128.0 GB of system memory at a balanced 1:4 core-to-RAM ratio. The architecture includes a 128 MB L3 cache and dedicated hardware AES support, though it lacks x86 vector extensions and includes no local scratch disks. Benchmark performance is highlighted by top-tier memory bandwidth, reaching 450.97 GB/sec on uncached reads and 188.48 GB/sec on writes, alongside upper-quartile multi-core compute throughput and high database operation metrics. Static web serving throughput reaches 52.72 GB/sec, and Redis SET operations hit 61.71 million operations per second. Lacking an integrated GPU or bundled storage, the instance delivers high execution consistency via dedicated single-threaded execution per core, making it effective for databases, distributed caches, compilation pipelines, and containerized web services.
